Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

=== absolute references into another section
        .text
        movl    $msg, %eax
        movl    msg, %ecx
        leal    msg + 4, %edx
        ret
        .data
        .space  0x100
msg:    .long   1

=== calls into another section
        .text
entry:
        call    helper
        call    helper@PLT
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
helper:
        ret

=== data across sections
        .text
entry:
        ret
        .data
        .long   entry
        .long   entry - .
        .long   entry@PLT

=== the location counter in each item of a data list
        .text
entry:
        ret
        .long   ., ., . - entry
        .byte   . - entry, . - entry
